summary: Reproduces on main (13730886e) and on all 20 stable releases back to v1.4.1907. A file-scope struct object is $Globals-backed, so a non-const method that writes a member produces a store into a constant buffer; the front end accepts it and DXIL lowering throws at cast<GetElementPtrInst> in HLOperationLower.cpp:8847. The same violation on a const local compiles silently, so the missing const diagnostic and the internal error are separable. Four distinct crash signatures across releases (two silent): an exit-status-only predicate would report it fixed at v1.7.2207, a message-text predicate a regression at v1.6.2106. Clang (hlsl_clang_trunk) diagnoses the construct, verified against a mutable-object control pane.
title: Internal Compiler error: calling method that modifies const object
